cd /workspace && cat > tmp/uniqfuzz.py <<'PYEOF'
import importlib.util, heapq, json, random, sys
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m","/workspace/submission/main.py")
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
gen3=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("g3","/workspace/tmp/gen3.py")
g3=importlib.util.module_from_spec(gen3); gen3.loader.exec_module(g3)

seen=set(); dups=[]
orig=heapq.heappush
def patched(hp, item):
    k=item[:5]
    key=(k[0],k[1],k[2],k[3])
    if key in seen:
        dups.append(key)
    seen.add(key)
    return orig(hp,item)
heapq.heappush=patched

bad=0; checked=0
for seed in range(80000,81200):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    obj=g3.gen(rng)
    if obj is None: continue
    seen.clear(); dups.clear()
    try:
        m.solve(obj)
    except m.Invalid:
        continue
    checked+=1
    if dups:
        bad+=1; print("DUPLICATE EVENT seed",seed,dups[:3])
        if bad>2: break
print("checked",checked,"duplicate-event cases",bad)
PYEOF
timeout 600 python3 tmp/uniqfuzz.py
